clips.title: The story
paras: Scarlet Crusaders watch the eastern road from the heights of Crusader Outpost. Their tower guards the approaches to the Scarlet Monastery and waits for Forsaken incursions.

Crusader Outpost watches the eastern road from bluffs above the valley. Scarlet sentries scan the route between Brill and Lordaeron’s eastern reaches, hoping to spot undead and scouting parties before they reach the Monastery gates. The tower also gives the garrison a way to flank forces marching up the valley toward their holy bastion.

Captain Vachon and other Scarlet officers keep the garrison on alert. They regard the woods as unhallowed ground stolen from humanity by monsters, not Forsaken territory. Travelers loyal to the Undercity face an ambush point near the bluffs, where crossbow bolts and cleansing steel await anyone who comes too close.
